services.title: Your website, from start to <1>finish</1>
services.lead: We design, publish and maintain your business website, with clear plans and hands-on work alongside you. Pick a plan and add the extra tools you need.

process.title: How we <1>work</1>
process.lead: Seven clear steps, from our first conversation to your live website.
process.step1Text: We talk about your business and recommend a plan.
process.step2Text: We sign the contract and you pay 50% to get started.
process.step3Text: You send us your texts, images, logo and access details.
process.step4Text: We build your site with your brand.
process.step5Text: You review the site and request adjustments.
process.step6Text: Once you approve, you pay the remaining 50%.
process.step7Text: We publish your website and support you with the free basic maintenance included in your plan.

extras.title: Add what you <1>need</1>
extras.lead: Each tool has a fixed price and adds business days to your plan's delivery.
extras.discount: Discount on extra tools: {{esencial}}, regular price · {{alamedida}}, {{alamedidaPct}}% · {{profesional}}, {{profesionalPct}}%
extras.externalNote: Some tools rely on external services (for example AI, messaging, payment gateways, databases or domains) whose costs are paid by the client. They may vary depending on the solution, and we will let you know when we quote.

analytics.desc: Measure visits and the results of your campaigns (includes a cookie notice).

reviews.desc: Show your customers' real reviews on your website.

blog.name: Self-managed blog
blog.desc: A secure dashboard to publish your own posts (title, description, content and photo) without depending on us. We recommend a maximum of 3 posts per week and 80 per year to keep your site fast.

booking.name: Bookings with Google Calendar
booking.desc: Your customers book appointments in your available hours and they are added to your Google Calendar.

paymentLinks.desc: Get paid with payment links from your own payment gateway account.

store.desc: Catalog, cart and online payment; every product includes an "Ask about this product" button that takes you to WhatsApp.

chatbot.name: AI chatbot
chatbot.desc: An assistant that answers your customers' frequently asked questions.

crm.name: Internal CRM
crm.desc: A private dashboard to organize the contacts and requests you receive.
